designationHistory.name: Tamarac Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Tamarac Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7902 on May 31, 1938, and it was renamed Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record; fws.gov page) and Pass B (order text; National Archives table) agree. Renamed Tamarac National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1938 (3 FR 1255)
